limitations: Real installed packaged tool path; no Electron renderer or desktop pre-turn triage. Does not establish that local source/UI fixes are shipped.
Axwise and code-execution wrappers are disabled; native developer tools are common to all arms. Actual tool inventory is retained.
Identical conditional prompt selects OMP editing when mounted. This measures a controlled route, not organic tool selection.
JEV-on with OMP-off has no evidence-review effect in this harness; desktop pre-turn JEV behavior is outside this experiment.
Hosted model alias and requested effort are fixed; underlying gateway model and provider cache state are not independently verified.
Two fresh isolated fixtures per arm, reversed second-round order. Small exploratory sample, not statistical proof.

A transparent localhost forwarder passes primary requests and real gateway responses unchanged; it records request effort/model, HTTP status and usage. Nested OMP calls still go directly through the installed gateway route.
Tool counts and primary request count are observed. Total model-call count and hidden OMP token usage are unavailable.
exclusionReason: Harness did not resolve installed ACP friendly titles/canonical metadata, denying approved todo and engineering tools. These are calibration inference costs, not product reliability failures. Six completed rows retained; runner was interrupted during seventh fixture, whose unflushed in-flight HTTP count is unknown.
